ns2:course.label: International Perspectives
ns2:course.description: This course provides cross-cultural learning experiences within the context of international community-based service learning. Students will explore human service delivery through direct involvement with international social service institutions. This cultural immersion course is a collaborative partnership between the University of Illinois School of Social Work and selected international universities. Countries visited, varies by semester. Course may be repeated in separate terms up to 12 undergrad hours if topics vary.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Course may be repeated in separate terms up to 12 undergrad hours if topics vary.
